static_methods.name: registerPendingAppsFromIndex
static_methods.description:
Registers the module's apps as pending from the data index, loaded on demand

Reads the generated directory<->app-name map (`ts-app-dirs.yaml,` written next to *apps_dir* by a previous full load) rather than scanning the filesystem, and for each mapped app that the data index (ProviderIndexUtil) exposes as a `"tsrest-"` app, registers it pending through the standard registerPendingApp() / registerPendingScheme() primitives — exactly the closures the catalogue and connection layers already use to trigger on-demand init.  The app implementation and its SDK are NOT loaded here; each app's JS is loaded from its directory only on first use (see initAppIntern()).
static_methods.return_description: the number of apps registered pending (0 if the map is missing/empty, e.g. before the index has ever been built — the caller then falls back to a full load)

params.name: apps_dir
params.description: the directory holding the per-app subdirectories (its parent holds the `ts-app-dirs.yaml` map)

static_methods.name: checkInProcessServer
static_methods.description:
Returns the in-process pool if active, starting it on demand if configured

Uses double-checked locking: first checks without the mutex for the fast path, then acquires the mutex and checks again to avoid races during lazy creation.
static_methods.return_description: the in-process pool, or NOTHING if not active and on-demand is not configured

static_methods.name: shutdownInProcessServer
static_methods.description:
Shuts the in-process server down if it's running

Calls shutdown() on the pool (which wakes waiting threads and sets the shutdown flag) rather than deleting the pool immediately, since concurrent threads may still be executing against the pool via checkInProcessServer()->execCall().

static_methods.name: captureAppClosures
static_methods.description:
Extracts app-level async closures in pool clone mode without modifying global state

This method must be kept in sync with registerApp(hash, pool) and registerAppIntern(). It captures all closures that would normally be registered during app registration: - Table/record closures: get_table_list, get_record_type, search_records, create_records, update_records, upsert_records, delete_records (direct app attributes) - REST modifier closures: post_auth (rest_modifiers.set_options_post_auth), post_auth_code (rest_modifiers.set_options_post_auth_code), conn_update (rest_modifiers.connection_update_option.code)

static_methods.name: captureActionClosures
static_methods.description:
Extracts action-level async closures in pool clone mode without modifying global state

This method must be kept in sync with generateApiDataProvider() and generateEventDataProvider(). It captures all closures that would normally be registered during action registration: - API closures: api_function, get_dynamic_request_type, get_dynamic_response_type, request_data_converter, response_data_converter - Event closures: get_dynamic_type, get_example_event_data, format_event_data, event_function - Webhook closures: webhook_register, webhook_deregister - Option closures: get_allowed_values, get_element_allowed_values, get_default_value, get_dependent_options, get_dependent_response_options, get_dynamic_type

static_methods.name: registerWebhookCreateDestroyApis
static_methods.description: Registers an API for creating a webhook

params.name: create
params.description: a callable value taking a hash argument with the following keys: - method (string): the HTTP method for the webhook - auth (int): one of: - QAUTH_NONE = 0 -> no auth required - QAUTH_QORUS = 1 -> authentication required - perms (list of strings): an optional list of string permissions when `auth` is 1 - callback (code): a callback taking the arguments passed to the webhook to generate events This callback must return a hash with `url` and `ctx` keys providing a URL string for the URL used for the webhook, and a context object for destroying the webhook, respectively

params.name: destroy
params.description: a callable value taking the hash returned by the *create* callback

static_methods.name: createWebhook

static_methods.return_description: the hash returned by the create callback with `url` and `ctx` keys

params.name: h
